decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly states Knut Korsæth received the Commander of the Order of St. Olav from King Olav V, while document d2 explicitly states he was bestowed the Commander of the Legion of Honour by the French Ambassador; these are distinct awards from different sources (Norway and France) and are not mutually exclusive.
